review_description: From the start everything unfolded extremely smoothly. We were contacted quickly and were given all the time necessary for us to understand the system suggested and why a less costly system than what we first wanted was better for us.  All appointments were timely, honoured and the installation process went very well. The workmanship was very tidy and we received a follow up call to see if the meter change went well. As of yet the new meter hasn’t been installed (requiring a seperate entity) so cannot comment as yet on the performance of the solar system installed but we are very confident it will go as planned. We know that our installer will be there for us if required. So far we are very happy with our choice in all regards.

Glenn has installed a Sungrow Hybrid Solar System on our house. Even though we have not bought the battery yet he was able to set the system up so we have Emergency Power Supply during the day from the solar alone. This was enough to keep the fridge, tv and internet running during the day on the two blackouts we had this summer. We look forward to getting the battery added soon so we can be virtually independent  from the grid. We are pleased with Glenn's professional service and would highly recommend Him.
